entities.summary: Darby Joseph Hendrickson is an American former professional ice hockey center. He played in the NHL with the Toronto Maple Leafs, New York Islanders, Vancouver Canucks, Minnesota Wild and the Colorado Avalanche, and is a former assistant coach with the Minnesota Wild for 14 seasons. Currently an assistant coach with the Nashville Predators.
